args: import sys; from pathlib import Path; file_path = Path(sys.argv[1]); relative = file_path.relative_to(Path(sys.argv[2])); parts = relative.with_suffix('').parts; parts = parts[1:] if parts[0] == 'src' else parts; print('Current file:', file_path); print('Module path:', '.'.join(parts))
